title: Related-Key-Resistant Key Schedule for GIFT-64[2021]
summary: GIFT-64[2021] variants have lower related-key differential active-S-box bounds; whether a redesigned key schedule can improve their resistance remains conjectural.

formal_statement.body: Construct a key schedule for GIFT-64[2021] variants that improves resistance to related-key differential attacks.

scope.domain: Key-schedule design for related-key differential resistance in GIFT-64[2021] block-cipher variants.
parameters: The 24 GIFT-64[2021] variants: target block-cipher instances
Key schedule: component to redesign for improved related-key differential resistance
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct a key schedule that improves the variants' resistance to related-key differential attacks.

citations.label: A Greater GIFT: Strengthening GIFT against Statistical Cryptanalysis

progress.summary: The paper reports that the variants use the original GIFT key schedule and have lower related-key differential active-S-box bounds. It conjectures that carefully crafting the key schedule can lift their resistance.
citation_labels: Ling Sun et al., A Greater GIFT: Strengthening GIFT against Statistical Cryptanalysis
